mapper.sql: SELECT 'SHOWROOM_ASSIGNMENT' AS source_id, a.id AS numeric_id, CAST(a.id AS CHAR) AS business_id, CONCAT('展厅补充指派:', a.id) AS task_key, '展厅' AS task_type, '展厅补充指派' AS source, CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT(CASE a.target_type WHEN 'COMPANY' THEN '公司' WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN '产品' ELSE a.target_type END, '#', a.target_id), CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CASE WHEN a.target_type = 'COMPANY' THEN CASE a.field_code WHEN 'development_history' THEN '发展历程' WHEN 'park_introduction' THEN '园区介绍' WHEN 'incubation_platform' THEN '孵化平台' WHEN 'subsidiary_overview' THEN '子公司概览' WHEN 'stock_info' THEN '股权信息' WHEN 'core_manufacturing_capability' THEN '核心制造能力' WHEN 'honors_awards' THEN '荣誉奖项' ELSE a.field_code END ELSE CASE a.field_code WHEN 'owner_company_id' THEN '所属公司' WHEN 'product_owner_type' THEN '产品归属/类型' WHEN 'lifecycle_stage' THEN '生命周期' WHEN 'target_market' THEN '在售国家' WHEN 'pipeline_layout' THEN 'BU' WHEN 'indication_content' THEN '适应症' WHEN 'core_selling_points' THEN '卖点文案' WHEN 'model_specification' THEN '型号规格' WHEN 'cover_image' THEN '封面' WHEN 'registration_certificate' THEN '注册证' WHEN 'clinical_effect' THEN '临床效果' WHEN 'fim_status' THEN 'FIM状态' WHEN '__PRODUCT_ALL_FIELDS__' THEN '整产品资料' ELSE a.field_code END END, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(n.template_content, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), '')) AS detail, '待处理' AS status_label, NULL AS created_at, NULL AS due_at FROM showroom_field_assignment a LEFT JOIN system_notify_message n ON n.id = a.notify_message_id AND n.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND n.deleted = 0 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.assignee_user_id = #{q.userId} AND a.status = 'OPEN'
